load_libnat_library: load the libnat CUDA or CPU library for non-autoregressive translation operations
get_ins_targets: compute insertion targets and masked tokens from input and output token sequences using Levenshtein distance
get_del_targets: compute deletion targets from input and output token sequences using Levenshtein distance
apply_ins_masks: apply insertion masks to reorder and expand input tokens and scores into output sequences
apply_del_words: apply deletion predictions to remove tokens from input sequences and reorder remaining tokens
